objective: Phantom owns its complete control plane and first-party production stack rather than delegating canonical authority to third-party platforms.
authority_rule: Third-party systems may be adapters, migration sources, interoperability boundaries, or temporary development dependencies; they are never Phantom canonical production authority.
elimination_rule: A third-party dependency is not considered eliminated until an equivalent Phantom-owned implementation is built, tested, verified, migrated, and independently evidenced.
no_false_completion_rule: Architecture or contracts do not prove physical ownership, public deployment, or operational independence.
